items.title: UNI Slides 29% in Four Weeks as Uniswap Liquidity Holds Steady
items.summary: The token has underperformed bitcoin and ether, while Uniswap still holds about $4 billion in liquidity.

items.title: Franklin Templeton adds $150 million in fund shares to XRP Ledger, all in one wallet
items.summary: Two subscriptions on Thursday nearly quadrupled the fund’s tokens on the network.

items.title: Wells Fargo and five others object to OKX-ICE tokenized stock listings: Report
items.summary: As of Friday, 22 companies had filed objections as part of the joint venture’s proposed tokenized stock platform under the SEC’s innovation exemption.

items.title: Netanyahu Considering Crypto Plan to Dodge Banking Sanctions on Israel
items.summary: Days before Israel’s election, Netanyahu said he has asked for a blockchain plan in case banks are hit with sanctions, and told Israelis to prepare for a rainy day after Trump.
